findings.summary: Schiller 9/11 first responder litigation: Keith Schiller and Lena Schiller were plaintiffs in Schiller v. A Russo Wrecking Inc. (1:07-cv-10078, SDNY), filed Nov 2, 2007, terminated Jan 25, 2011. Nature: Personal Injury. Case involved World Trade Center Properties LLC and dozens of contractors/demolition companies. Attorney: Christopher R. LoPalo of Worby Groner Edelman & Napoli Bern LLP (known 9/11 first responder litigation firm). This confirms Schiller was likely a 9/11 first responder during his NYPD service, consistent with his timeline as NYPD officer in Manhattan through 2004.

KS Global Group LLC: Schiller's personal security consulting firm. Formed Oct 30, 2017 in Florida (doc M17000009224), registered at 433 Plaza Real Suite 275, Boca Raton FL 33432. Delaware predecessor formed Oct 2015. Received total of $585,500 from Republican National Committee (2017-2021) for security consulting: $15,000/month starting Oct 2017, cumulative $75K by Feb 2018, $225K by Feb 2019, $585.5K through 2021. Work included 2020 RNC convention security planning in Charlotte NC. FEC filings from 2021 show Schiller self-identified as employer: KS Global Group LLC, occupation: consultant.

Schiller-Pakistan FARA subcontracting structure: Seiden Law LLP (Robert W. Seiden, Managing Partner) won the primary FARA contract with Pakistan Embassy on April 8, 2025 at $200K/month. Javelin Advisors was subcontracted at $50K/month for 6 months. The arrangement structurally distances Schiller from the direct foreign government contract while still providing his White House access. Schiller co-signed the FARA Exhibit B Amendment on May 9, 2025 (same day as India's Operation Sindoor airstrikes) expanding scope to include Jammu & Kashmir dispute and Pakistan-India relations. This is the same structure described in the Global Witness report: Seiden outsourced the Pakistan contract to a firm owned by Trump's former bodyguard.

findings.summary: Schiller pardon-brokering portfolio: Javelin Advisors registered to lobby for two convicted felons seeking presidential clemency in 2025. (1) Fred Daibes - NJ businessman convicted of bribing Sen. Bob Menendez with cash and gold bars, serving 7-year sentence at FCI Fairton NJ. Paid $1M to Javelin for 'executive relief.' Engagement ended June 2025. (2) Greg E. Lindberg - NC billionaire insurance executive convicted of bribery, wire fraud, and insurance fraud in $2B scheme, serving federal sentence. Hired Javelin Q3 2025. NC Insurance Commissioner Mike Causey and US Senators Tillis and Budd publicly opposed his pardon. Both clients used Schiller's former White House position as their access point to the current administration.

findings.summary: Schiller FEC political donation pattern (Boca Raton FL address only): 2021-03-15: $2,900 to Texans for Ronny Jackson (listed RETIRED). 2021-06-22: $5,800 to Max Miller for Congress via WinRed (listed KS GLOBAL GROUP LLC/CONSULTANT). 2025-09-08: $5,000 to Team Katie (Katie Britt joint fundraiser) via WinRed (listed SELF-EMPLOYED/CONSULTANT). 2025-10-27: $4,000 total to Texans for Ronny Jackson ($3,500 primary + $500 general) (listed RETIRED). Total identified: ~$18,600 across 2021-2025. All recipients are Trump-aligned Republicans. Ronny Jackson (former WH physician, TX-13), Max Miller (Trump aide, OH), Katie Britt (AL Senate). Jackson sits on House Armed Services Committee. Britt sits on Senate Foreign Relations and Banking Committees.

Schiller I-MEI Foods Taiwan defense lobbying: Javelin Advisors signed contract with I-MEI Foods Co Ltd (Taiwan) registered Q4 2025, with LDA issue code: Defense. Description: Government contracts concerning food products, cybersecurity and/or robotics. Three affiliated Taiwanese entities listed in FARA filing as foreign entity issues: Tansimo Robotic Manufacturing Inc, Chelpis Quantum Corp, Golden Saddle Machinery Co Ltd. Lobbyists: Keith Schiller, George Sorial, Robert Wayne Seiden. Schiller visited I-MEI factory in Longtan, Taoyuan for signing. This represents Javelin expanding into Taiwan defense/tech lobbying while maintaining Pakistan FARA representation — two nations with significant US defense equities.

Javelin Advisors LLC complete client roster and revenue (2025): Schiller is contact person and Managing Director. Six clients identified via LDA Senate filings: (1) CAPSTONE USA ADVISORY GROUP LLC (NY) - Ukraine reconstruction lobbying, registered Dec 2024, $300K income Q3 2025; (2) FRED DAIBES - executive relief/pardon brokering, $1M income Q1 2025, terminated by June 2025; (3) LOGICAL STRATEGIES LLC (NY) - EPA asbestos rule and government contracts, $1.2M income Q3 2025, no Q4 activity; (4) GREG E. LINDBERG - executive clemency/pardon for insurance fraud conviction, registered Q3 2025, under $5K; (5) NIOCORP DEVELOPMENTS LTD - critical minerals funding/contracts, $400K income Q4 2025; (6) I-MEI FOODS CO LTD (Taiwan) - defense contracts for food/cybersecurity/robotics, registered Q4 2025. Total disclosed LDA income: ~$2.9M. Plus FARA income from Pakistan (~$300K at $50K/month for 6 months). Schiller is listed as lobbyist on all six LDA clients.

Keith Schiller biographical profile: Born ~1959 in The Bronx, raised in Hudson Valley, graduated New Paltz High School 1977. US Navy 1978-1982 (Radioman Third Class, USS Plymouth Rock). NY State Division for Youth counselor 8 years. Plattekill Police Dept part-time officer. NYPD 1992-2004: transit cop, patrol officer, narcotics detective (Street Narcotics Enforcement Unit). Began as Trump bodyguard 1999 while still NYPD. Full-time Trump Org Director of Security 2004-2017. Deputy Assistant to President / Director of Oval Office Operations Jan-Sep 2017. Delivered Comey termination letter May 9, 2017. Testified to House Intelligence Committee Nov 7, 2017 re: Moscow 2013 Miss Universe trip. Primary residence: 6004 Vista Linda Ln, Boca Raton FL 33433. Born 1959, currently lists as retired on some FEC filings.

Schiller PEP status confirmed: OpenSanctions lists Keith Schiller (Q28730223) as a Politically Exposed Person (topics: role.pep). Born 1959, The Bronx. Education: New York City Police Academy, New Paltz High School. Citizenship: US. Political affiliation: Republican Party. Datasets: wikidata, wd_categories. First seen 2024-09-03, last seen 2026-02-13. No sanctions or enforcement listings found.

Schiller represented by Schertler Onorato Mead & Sears LLP: LittleSis records a generic relationship between Keith Schiller and DC white-collar defense firm Schertler Onorato Mead & Sears (now Schertler Onorato Mead Sears & Manning). This DC firm specializes in white-collar criminal defense and government investigations. Likely representation during House Intelligence Committee testimony (Nov 2017) or Mueller investigation. Founding partners David Schertler and Danny Onorato are former federal prosecutors.
